teaser.en: A forest shrub with coffee-like leaves, studied for compounds that fight skin fungi.
teaser.sw: Kichaka cha msituni chenye majani yanayofanana na ya mbuni, kinachochunguzwa kwa kemikali zake zinazopambana na fangasi wa ngozi.
teaser.dg: Chitsaka cha tsakani chenye makodza dza ga kahawa, ambacho kemikalize zinahenderwa utafiti kpwa kuolaga fangasi za ngozi.

summary.en: Mpukuse is an understorey shrub of the East African coastal forests, with glossy, coffee-like leaves. It belongs to the dogbane family.
summary.sw: Mpukuse ni kichaka kinachoota chini ya miti mikubwa katika misitu ya pwani ya Afrika Mashariki, chenye majani yanayong'aa yanayofanana na ya mbuni. Ni wa familia ya Apocynaceae.
summary.dg: Mpukuse ni chitsaka chinachomera photsi ya mihi mire kpwenye matsaka ga pwani ya Afrika Mashariki, chenye makodza ganang'ala dza ga kahawa. Ni mmea wa jamii ya mkode.

about.en: *Mpukuse* is a shrub or small tree of the forest understorey. Its glossy, opposite leaves look like coffee leaves, which is what *coffaeoides* means. The flowers are small, white to yellowish and tubular, and the fruits are paired pods. Like many plants of the family, it is rich in alkaloids.
about.sw: *Mpukuse* ni kichaka au mti mdogo unaoota chini ya miti mikubwa msituni. Majani yake yanayong'aa, yanayoota kwa jozi zinazotazamana, yanafanana na majani ya mbuni, na hiyo ndiyo maana ya *coffaeoides*. Maua ni madogo, meupe hadi ya manjano hafifu na yenye umbo la mrija, na matunda ni maganda yaliyo kwa jozi. Kama mimea mingi ya familia hii, una alkaloidi kwa wingi.
about.dg: *Mpukuse* ni chitsaka au muhi mdide unaomera photsi ya mihi mire tsakani. Makodzage ganang'ala, ganamera jozi-jozi, na ganahalana na makodza ga kahawa; ndivyo *coffaeoides* inavyomaanisha. Maruwa ni madide, ga rangi nyereru hadi rangi ya mandano ngushu-ngushu, na ni dza mrija; matunda ni makakaya ganayomera mairi-mairi. Dza mimea minji ya jamii hino, una kemikali nyinji za *alkaloid*.

where.en: It grows in the shade of coastal and lowland forest in Kenya and Tanzania.
where.sw: Unaota kivulini katika misitu ya pwani na ya nyanda za chini nchini Kenya na Tanzania.
where.dg: Unamera pephoni kpwenye matsaka ga pwani na ga herera, Kenya na Tanzania.

uses.en: Pakia records no Digo use. In Kenya the leaves are used in traditional medicine for skin conditions, and researchers have studied their alkaloids for antifungal activity.
uses.sw: Pakia haandiki matumizi yoyote miongoni mwa Wadigo. Nchini Kenya majani yake hutumika katika dawa za asili kutibu matatizo ya ngozi, na watafiti wamechunguza alkaloidi zake kwa uwezo wake wa kupambana na fangasi.
uses.dg: Pakia kaandika matumizi ga Adigo. Kenya makodzage nkuhumirwa kpwa dawa za chienyeji za makongo ga ngozi, na asayansi akahenda utafiti kpwa kemikali zao za *alkaloid* kulola kukala zinaweza kuolaga fangasi.

names.en: Pakia records *mpukuse* with no meaning, and no other language sharing it. There is no English or Swahili name in the sources.
names.sw: Pakia anaandika *mpukuse* bila maana yake, na hakuna lugha nyingine inayotumia jina hili. Vyanzo havitoi jina la Kiingereza wala la Kiswahili.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika *mpukuse* bila kulavya mana ya dzina hiri, na kaandika luga yanjina inayohumira dzina hiri. Maandiko tagana dzina ra Chingereza wala ra Chiswahili.

reason.en: Rauvolfia, a forest shrub of the same family
reason.sw: Rauvolfia, kichaka cha msituni cha familia ileile
reason.dg: Rauvolfia, chitsaka cha tsakani cha jamii mwenga
